name_zh: 麦克唐纳/皮尔逊/联邦奠基人：联邦共识制与责任政府
name_en: Macdonald/Pearson/Federal Founders: Federal Consensus & Responsible Government
description_zh: 约翰·麦克唐纳 (1815-1891) 加拿大首任总理，主导 1867 《英属北美法案》建立联邦制，以"太平洋铁路"捆绑西部入盟；莱斯特·皮尔逊 (1897-1972) 推动《权利法案》前身、旗帜/医保/养老金、诺贝尔和平奖得主（苏伊士运河维和）。两人跨保守/自由党，共同体现 M164 联邦共识制——以"责任政府+联邦分权+跨党派妥协"三位一体，在英法双文化张力中构建可扩展的联邦契约。
description_en: John A. Macdonald (1815-1891) Canada's first PM, drove 1867 British North America Act establishing federation, bound West via "transcontinental railway"; Lester B. Pearson (1897-1972) advanced Bill of Rights precursor, flag/medicare/pensions, Nobel Peace laureate (Suez peacekeeping). Across Conservative/Liberal, both exemplify M164 Federal Consensus—trinity of "responsible government + federal devolution + cross-party compromise" building expandable federal contract amid Anglo-Franco cultural tension.
reason_zh: 加拿大非单一民族国家，联邦制源于"英法双文化妥协+原住民条约+移民多元化"三重契约。麦克唐纳奠定联邦骨架，皮尔逊将其现代化为多元文化福利国家。M164 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉)、M162 多元文化联邦(当代)，核心在于"责任政府+联邦分权"的渐进式契约扩展。
reason_en: Canada not a single-nation state, federation rooted in trinity of 'Anglo-Franco compromise + indigenous treaties + immigrant pluralism'. Macdonald laid federal skeleton, Pearson modernized into multicultural welfare state. M164 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultation) and M162 Multicultural Federation (contemporary), core: 'responsible government + federal devolution' gradual contract expansion.
steps_zh: 1867 联邦奠基：英属北美法案确立联邦/省分权、君主立宪、责任政府
国家横贯铁路：CPR 1885 完工，物理捆绑不列颠哥伦比亚入盟，主权延伸至太平洋
双文化制度化：魁北克民法典/天主教学校权利联邦宪法保护，英语省普通法并存
皮尔逊现代化：1965 新旗帜/1966 医保/1967 养老金/《权利法案》前身，福利国家联邦化
1982 宪法本土化：特鲁多父主导《权利与自由宪章》、修正公式、原住民权利第 35 条
steps_en: 1867 Confederation founding: BNA Act establishes federal/provincial division, constitutional monarchy, responsible government
Transcontinental railway: CPR 1885 completed, physically binds BC entry, sovereignty extends to Pacific
Bicultural institutionalization: Quebec civil code/Catholic school rights constitutionally protected, common law provinces coexist
Pearson modernization: 1965 new flag/1966 medicare/1967 pensions/Bill of Rights precursor, welfare state federalized
1982 Constitution patriation: Trudeau père drives Charter of Rights/f amending formula/indigenous rights s.35
expected_zh: 以"责任政府+联邦分权+跨文化妥协"三位一体，实现从殖民地自治领到多元文化联邦国家的渐进式演进，零内战/零分裂。
expected_en: Trinity of 'responsible government + federal devolution + cross-cultural compromise' achieves gradual evolution from colonial dominion to multicultural federal state, zero civil war/zero secession.
case_zh: 1867 四省联邦→1870 魁北克/曼尼托巴→1871 BC→1873 PEI→1898 育空→1905 阿尔伯塔/萨省→1949 纽芬兰→1999 努纳武特，联邦弹性容纳 10 省 3 地。
case_en: 1867 four-province confederation -> 1870 QC/MB -> 1871 BC -> 1873 PEI -> 1898 Yukon -> 1905 AB/SK -> 1949 NL -> 1999 NU, federal elasticity accommodates 10 provinces 3 territories.
intellectual_tradition: Canadian Federalism / Responsible Government / Bicultural Compact
cross_cultural_impact: Federal model for diverse societies; bilingual constitutionalism; peaceful accommodation template
colonial_history: British/French colonial origins; Confederation 1867; gradual sovereignty
resource_curse_mitigation: Resource revenue sharing (equalization payments); provincial resource ownership (s.92A)
climate_adaptation: Northern infrastructure; permafrost engineering; ice road logistics
